verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only Intel marketing copy about GPU/AI features, Copilot+, gaming, and developer tools — no independent single-thread benchmark data or third-party reviews validating everyday responsiveness claims are present. missing for 10: independent single-thread benchmark results (e.g., Cinebench, Geekbench single-core), third-party reviews confirming real-world snappiness, any comparative data versus competitors.
